caption:
In 1939 a quiet carpenter spent more than thirty nights hiding in a Munich beer hall, hollowing out the pillar behind Hitler's lectern by flashlight. On 8 November his bomb went off right on time.

Read it free: https://ww2dispatches.substack.com/p/thirteen-minutes-in-munich
